title: Remediation list for a contact
description: For one person who fixes things, in the penetration test report's format: who the list is for and what is past or near its deadline, then each finding assigned to them with its description, impact, evidence and recommendation, and the deadline on every affected system. Prepared on demand from the Remediation page; never issued or frozen.

assets.label: Company logo
assets.description: Word: in place of the YOUR LOGO placeholder on the title page and in the header of every page, scaled to fit a 1.7 × 0.5 inch box (a logo wider than it is tall fits best). HTML: above the report title, up to 2 inches wide. A PNG with a transparent background reads best.

assets.label: Title page image
assets.description: Word: in place of the COVER IMAGE placeholder, the large picture on the title page, scaled to fit a 7.5 × 5 inch box (a 3:2 landscape picture fills it). A JPEG photo or artwork.
assets.note: Without it the title page shows the grey COVER IMAGE placeholder; to have no picture there, remove it from your own Word styles file.

assets.label: Word styles (reference.docx)
assets.description: Fonts, colours, heading and table styles, page size, the title page layout and the header/footer of the Word report. The logo and title page image above are placed without it; for anything else, start from a copy of the shipped reference.docx, replace its CLASSIFICATION text with your own, change its styles in Word (not its body text) and save it here.
assets.note: Screenshot captions and figures are centred by the ImageCaption and Captioned Figure styles; keep those styles in your copy.
